name: Ariane In Paradise
source:
Rachel is in a work trip to the tropical island of Duquesne, where she is doing photo shoots for the entire week. Ariane decided to follow Rachel and this leaves her all alone during the daytime hours to find some fun things to do. The protagonist is on vacation alone on the same island and he just happens to meet Ariane at the hotel pool.

[Edited from [url=https://arianeb.com/2018/07/22/my-next-game-ariane-in-paradise/]arianeb.com[/url]]
translation:
雷切尔正在前往热带岛屿杜肯岛出差，她在那里花了整整一周的时间拍摄照片。阿丽亚娜决定跟随瑞秋，这让她在白天独自一人寻找一些有趣的事情做。主角独自在同一个岛上度假，恰好在酒店泳池遇见了阿丽亚娜。

[编辑自[url=https://arianeb.com/2018/07/22/my-next-game-ariane-in-paradise/]arianeb.com[/url]]
